title: A damped mass on a spring
intro: A 1 kg mass on a spring is pulled aside and let go. A small WebAssembly module computes the motion step by step for 2.5 s. Change the spring, the damping and the start, and watch how fast the swings die out.
checkLeft: At most 5 % of the starting energy is left after 2.5 s.
checkK: The spring constant is still 4 N/m.
